name: one-click
description: Turn bounded website requirements into a structured, reviewable Lovable website brief from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: One Click turns the minimum website requirements for the current task into a structured, reviewable website brief. The current release does not read or save a One Click account, persist the business brief, create a project or deploy a website. A separate Lovable action is used only after the user authorises external project creation.
